entry_and_gating.source_intent: Confirmed upcoming earnings, an event-spanning call calendar, coherent liquidity, and favorable term-structure/volatility evidence.
entry_and_gating.implementation: Confirmed event and eligible expiration gap are hard gates; coherent quotes/open interest are hard liquidity gates; weak or unknown supplemental volume downgrades PASS to WATCH; term richness and ATM-IV versus realized volatility drive the score.

expiration_rules.source_intent: Front expiration before earnings and back expiration after earnings; legacy configuration used front 7-21 DTE, back 14-70 DTE, and gap 14-63 days.
expiration_rules.implementation: Front 7-21 DTE, back 22-75 DTE, event spanning, target gap 30 days with inclusive 5-day tolerance, then minimum deviation from 30.

strike_or_delta_selection.implementation: Nearest common strike call calendar across the selected expirations.

earnings_treatment.source_intent: A confirmed earnings event must lie between the two expirations.
earnings_treatment.implementation: Confirmed event evidence is required and the chosen pair spans it.

formula.source_intent: Prefer favorable term structure with front volatility evaluated against realized volatility; debit is observable structure economics.
formula.implementation: Named term_structure_richness and atm_iv_vs_realized_volatility factors feed the versioned two-factor score; midpoint and conservative debit are projected separately.

liquidity.source_intent: Legacy configuration used spread <= 15%, open interest >= 50, and volume >= 10 as acceptance filters.
liquidity.implementation: PR #254 deliberately froze coherent quotes and positive open interest as hard gates and coarse volume as supplemental evidence that can downgrade PASS to WATCH.

structure_substitution.source_intent: A calendar is required; a diagonal is not equivalent.
structure_substitution.implementation: Exact same-strike calendar intent is resolved without substitution; a different shape is typed different_structure_available.

lifecycle_and_exit.source_intent: Source material defines opportunity discovery, not an exit policy.
lifecycle_and_exit.implementation: Opportunity lifecycle states watching/confirmed are declared; no exit thresholds or broker actions are invented.

entry_and_gating.source_intent: Buy farther volatility and sell richer nearer volatility when the forward factor is attractive and the intended double calendar is liquid.
entry_and_gating.implementation: PASS at factor >= 0.20, WATCH at >= 0.12, with confirmed-earnings exclusion, common-strike completeness, and liquidity gates.

expiration_rules.implementation: Deterministic windows front 35-90 DTE, back 49-139 DTE, gap 14-49 days, targeting front 60 and gap 30.

strike_or_delta_selection.source_intent: Matched call and put calendars near absolute 0.35 delta.
strike_or_delta_selection.implementation: Delta-selected call and put legs target absolute 0.35 and require common strikes across expiration pairs.

earnings_treatment.source_intent: Use ex-earnings front IV, but the source does not define a reproducible earnings-premium removal method.
earnings_treatment.implementation: PR #253 truthfully names raw front IV and excludes confirmed earnings through the back expiration instead of fabricating an adjustment.

formula.implementation: The canonical forward-variance and forward-factor formulas are preserved with Decimal and typed invalid-domain handling.

liquidity.source_intent: All four intended legs must be executable; exact numeric thresholds were not established in the source specification.
liquidity.implementation: All intended legs require coherent bid/ask, bounded spread, open interest, and volume under the accepted manifest policy.

structure_substitution.source_intent: The intended matched-strike double calendar must exist.
structure_substitution.implementation: Resolver does not silently substitute a diagonal or other structure; alternatives remain diagnostic only.

lifecycle_and_exit.implementation: NO_LIFECYCLE; no exit policy or broker action is invented.

entry_and_gating.source_intent: Legacy v1 combined skew and momentum into an options-vertical opportunity.
entry_and_gating.implementation: Founder-approved v2 research requires a historical skew stretch, volatility-value gates, and at least two of three momentum dimensions; PASS/WATCH/FAIL/UNKNOWN semantics are explicit.

expiration_rules.source_intent: Use the nearest suitable future option expiration.
expiration_rules.implementation: Nearest future expiration is selected deterministically from sealed option evidence.

strike_or_delta_selection.source_intent: Verticals use a near-ATM long leg and an out-of-the-money wing.
strike_or_delta_selection.implementation: Long leg targets absolute delta 0.50 and short wing targets absolute delta 0.25, with exact legs retained.

earnings_treatment.source_intent: No earnings gate is defined for this strategy.
earnings_treatment.implementation: No earnings capability or hidden earnings filter is introduced.

formula.source_intent: Assess skew stretch and directional momentum.
formula.implementation: Issue #255 freezes z-score <= -2.0 over 60 observations (40 minimum), ATM IV-RV <= 0, wing IV-RV > 0, wing IV-ATM IV > 0, and equal-weight 20-session time-series/cross-sectional/sector-relative alignment.

liquidity.source_intent: Selected vertical legs must be liquid.
liquidity.implementation: Each leg requires spread ratio <= 0.15, open interest >= 50, and volume >= 10.

structure_substitution.implementation: Exact vertical intent is retained; another shape never upgrades constructibility.

lifecycle_and_exit.source_intent: No authorized exit policy is defined.
lifecycle_and_exit.implementation: NO_LIFECYCLE; no exit thresholds or broker actions are invented.

conclusion: The three accepted production definitions are implemented consistently. Differences from the pinned Stonk source are documented Founder-authorized refinements or fail-closed treatment of unspecified behavior; OT-01 found no clear implementation error and makes no runtime change.
